description: Mark a comment on an HTMLAnnotate page as resolved (done), or reopen it. Use after the requested change has been made. Everyone in the thread gets an email when it is resolved. To set it to in progress, or change its priority, labels or assignee, use set_comment_status.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page.

number.description: The comment number as shown by get_comments, like 3 for #3.

resolved.description: true to resolve (default), false to reopen.

name: resolve_comment
title: Mark a comment resolved
